dogecoin.text:
Built to Last 📈
Generic memecoins come and go, but IP memecoins have staying power. Why? Because they’re tied to something timeless—a meme, a brand, or a character that people won’t forget.  
Dogecoin and Shiba Inu have survived multiple market cycles because of this.

They’ve Got the Meme Power 
IP memecoins are built on memes or characters people already know and love. Think Dogecoin’s Shiba Ingo or Pepe the Frog.  
When a coin has that kind of cultural clout, it’s got instant recognition and a ready-made community. That’s how you go viral.
